trigger: End-to-end extraction showed that maximizing factor-point density alone overpays in relation-matrix rank and SAT complexity.
objective: Find the n=17 Pareto frontier over factor-space dimension, basis sparsity, exact relation coverage, rank requirement and encoding size.
families: fixed trace-zero direction basis translated by one
exhaustively density-selected coordinate subset of trace-zero sparse directions, selected without relation targets
previously observed dimension-5 all-lifting affine flat as an explicitly labeled exploratory candidate
schedules: For each base, score [0,0,0], [0,1,2], and the best [0,e,f] over 0 <= e <= f < 17.
selection: Report a Pareto frontier. Do not collapse mathematical relation cost and solver-size proxies into one unsupported scalar.
controls: Use a complete subgroup logarithm table only to accelerate exact coverage scoring; verify reported frontier coverages by actual curve additions.
success: A lower-dimensional point with lower expected systems and competitive encoding size earns end-to-end SAT extraction. This screen itself is not a breakthrough.
exploratory_flat_provenance: offset 48581 and basis [70724,4642,8208,34008,2066] came from a 2000-restart exploratory search with exact final membership checks; it was not the output of the frozen sparse selector.
